The '''First Wookiee Expeditionary Force''' was a name coined by [[Shoran]] to describe a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] strike team that was put together in [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]] to rescue [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] from the [[Duskhan League]].

In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the Wookiee Chewbacca traveled to his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] to help guide his son [[Lumpawaroo/Legends|Lumpawarrump]] through the traditional coming-of-age [[Hrrtayyk ceremony/Legends|Hrrtayyk ceremony]]. When he found out that Solo, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] whom he had long ago sworn a [[Life debt/Legends|life debt]] to, had been kidnapped, he immediately halted the ceremony and prepared to depart the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in Solo's [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. Although he intended to go alone, his cousins [[Jowdrrl]], [[Dryanta]], and Shoran insisted on accompanying him, asserting that his entire family was responsible for the life debt and that it would be too dangerous a [[Mission to the Koornacht Cluster|mission]] to go on alone. Lumpawarrump was eager to complete his hrrtayyk at his [[Parent/Legends|father's]] side and joined the strike team immediately prior to their departure.

The team went first to [[Esau's Ridge]] on [[Tholatin]] and obtained valuable information on the Duskhan League and the [[Koornacht Cluster/Legends|Koornacht Cluster]] in which they lived, information that was secretly channeled to them by the clandestine [[New Republic Intelligence Service|New Republic Intelligence]] agency [[Alpha Blue]]. They afterward proceeded directly to the Koornacht [[Star cluster/Legends|Cluster]] and were able to rescue Solo with the aid of the [[Fallanassi/Legends|Fallanassi]] adept [[Enara]]. Shoran was [[Death/Legends|killed]], and Lumpawarrump completed his Hrrtayyk. They then brought Solo and Shoran's corpse to the [[Intrepid (Endurance-class)|''Intrepid'']], a starship of the [[New Republic Fifth Fleet|New Republic Fifth Battle Group]], where the former was put in a [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]] and the latter taken to a morgue.
